segments.name: Mining
segments.description: The mining segment mines, beneficiates and sells material mined from the Company's mining rights in Brazil, with other projects in exploration phase.
segments.evidence: The Company has one reportable segment: mining. The mining segment derives revenue in Brazil by mining, beneficiating and selling material mined from the Company's several mining rights.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay the Company for material mined and beneficiated from its mining rights, currently quartzite and iron ore, sold in Brazil.
revenueModel.evidence: The mining segment derives revenue in Brazil by mining, beneficiating and selling material mined from the Company's several mining rights. Currently the Company generates revenue solely from two operating projects: Quartzite and Iron Ore.
